content:
I found this file but I don't see documentation for this API. Is there any?

I've been working on some Rust apps that run on iOS and Android. I create an FFI adapter layer that connects Rust with Objective-C or Java/JNI. I'm curious if such a think is possible in Lean.
I don't think there is too much beyond https://lean-lang.org/doc/reference/latest/Run-Time-Code/Foreign-Function-Interface/#ffi
Okay. I'll have to experiment. I can't tell if there's enough there in the FFI API to wrap something like UIKit.
I made a project to build iOS apps with Lean - seeing how the FFI works in the examples might be helpful for you https://github.com/paulcadman/lean-ios
